2026-07-30.content:
Support for retrieving, listing, enabling, and disabling Model Context Protocol
(MCP) servers and tools using the Cloud API Registry API is shut
down. For supported services, [MCP endpoints
are available once you enable the API](https://docs.cloud.google.com/mcp/manage-mcp-servers). For more information, see
[Feature deprecations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/api-registry/docs/deprecations).

summary.title: MCP server and tool support shut down
summary.summary: Support for managing Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools via the Cloud API Registry API has been shut down. For continued support, please refer to the documentation for enabling MCP endpoints on supported services.

2026-07-24.content:
As of July 30, 2026, support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools
will be shut down. You will not be able to retrieve, list, enable, and disable
MCP servers and tools using the Cloud API Registry API. For more
information, see
[Feature deprecations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/api-registry/docs/deprecations).

summary.title: MCP Server and Tool Support Ending
summary.summary: Support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools will be discontinued on July 30, 2026. After this date, MCP servers and tools will no longer be accessible or manageable through the Cloud API Registry API. Further details can be found in the feature deprecations documentation.

2026-04-30.content:
Support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools is deprecated. As of
the July 30, 2026 shutdown date, you can no longer retrieve, list, enable,
and disable MCP servers and tools using the Cloud API Registry
API. For more information, see
[Feature deprecations](https://docs.cloud.google.com/api-registry/docs/deprecations).

summary.title: MCP support deprecated
summary.summary: Support for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools is deprecated. As of the July 30, 2026 shutdown date, these tools will no longer be available through the Cloud API Registry API. For more details, please refer to the feature deprecations documentation.

2025-12-10.content:
Cloud API Registry is available in
[Preview](https://cloud.google.com/products/#product-launch-stages).

Cloud API Registry lets you discover, govern, use, and monitor
Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and tools provided by Google, or by your
organization through Apigee API hub. For more information, see the
[Cloud API Registry overview](https://docs.cloud.google.com/api-registry/docs/overview).

summary.title: API Registry Now in Preview
summary.summary: Cloud API Registry, a new service for discovering, governing, and using API servers and tools, is now available in preview. It supports both Google-provided and your organization's APIs through Apigee API hub, offering enhanced API management capabilities.
